import sys

input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().splitlines()

# Read number of instructions
n = int(data[0])

# Start from the North Pole
position = 0

# Flag to check the validity of the journey
valid = True

# Process each part of the journey
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    t, dir = data[i].split()
    t = int(t)

    if dir == "North":
        position -= t
    elif dir == "South":
        position += t
    elif dir == "East" or dir == "West":
        # East and West only allowed if not at the Poles
        if position == 0 or position == 20000:
            valid = False

    # Check if the journey is valid at each step
    if position < 0 or position > 20000:
        valid = False
        break

# The journey must end at the North Pole
if position != 0:
    valid = False

print("YES" if valid else "NO")
